newsitem.title: USA: Ohio banks Park National, First-Knox Banc to merge.
newsitem.headline: Ohio banks Park National, First-Knox Banc to merge.

text.p: Park National Corp. said Tuesday it signed an agreement to acquire First-Knox Banc Corp. in a deal valued at $114.3 million.
Under terms of the agreement, First-Knox shareholders will receive 0.5914 share of Park common stock for each share of First-Knox in a tax-free exchange.
Newark, Ohio-based Park said it expects to issue 2.345 million shares to acquire Mount Vernon, Ohio-based First-Knox. The deal will be accounted for as a pooling-of-interests.
First-Knox shares fell $2 to $27 on Nasdaq, while Park fell 12.5 cents to $48.75 in American Stock Exchange trading.
